verdict.rationale: Lovable documents iterative refinement through chat: follow-ups, corrections, and new ideas can steer Build mode at any time, and changes appear as file diffs and summaries. It also offers indirect safety nets: per-collaborator drafts with their own preview, GitHub branches and pull requests for testing features, and an edit history to review what changed. The 'without breaking what already works' part is only implied by those tools, not documented as a guarantee. Missing for 10: documented one-click revert/rollback to a prior working version, any regression-prevention or testing of existing functionality during edits, and independent hands-on corroboration that follow-up prompts preserve working features.
